data.body: Implemented in Gerrit change 2160 and landed on main as ae4030bd4a920762e27971f59a7aafdc4fcc0026. The canonical adopter template now uses rebar claim <id>, covers configured and empty ticket.default_assignee states, limits email or accountId requirements to explicit overrides in Jira-reconciled stores, includes caused_by, and orders prerequisite review before dependent review. The generated region matches the canonical source byte for byte. The focused suite passed 13 tests, CI run 32669968935 passed, and the template contains no Gerrit workflow guidance.
